name: Comfey

abilities.name: Flower Shield
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any {Psychic} Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can’t be affected by any Special Conditions.

flavor:
Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates
itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t
wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.
